title: Follow the links
description: An array-backed linked list stores nodes as [value, next_index]. -1 is the null pointer. Implement read_list(nodes, head) to return reachable values in order. Raise ValueError for a cycle or any pointer outside the array other than -1. Unreachable nodes can be ignored.
hints: The array position does not determine the logical order.
Keep visited indices to detect a cycle.
